facts.fact: A rider from Kettamala brings Bhaskaran a strip in Rema's hand at the Resin House gate: she expects the Keeper's quire within two days or she comes for it. Devan tells Bhaskaran to say he is sitting on it and hearing all of it first, and risks a charge by doing so.
Asha at ten drew the west-stair parrot newel whole, saying a broken beak insulted the bird, and drew it mended on every note thereafter (consistent with F111).
Devan orders both ends of the master's-room passage left open with no man posted, moves the mat to the wall away from the door, and sets a brass water pot spout-left by it.
Pavi's green salve smells of crushed leaf and smoke, distinct from Eravi's tamarind-scented salve (F462).
Devan's palms are rope-burned from the well shaft rope and the pry bar.
